# 1. Running RRA for all studies
```{r}
## Set P value cutoff as 0.05
path_RRA <- "/Users/wchen20/Desktop/PCAWG/CRISPR/CRISPRscreen20240118/RRA/fdr_005/"
path_RRA_leaveout <- "/Users/wchen20/Desktop/PCAWG/CRISPR/CRISPRscreen20240118/RRA/fdr_005_leaveout/"

cut_off = 0.05

for (cell_type in c("NKcells", "Tcells", "MHCregulators")) {
  
  if(cell_type == "MHCregulators") {
    path_CRISPR <- paste0("/Users/wchen20/Desktop/PCAWG/CRISPR/CRISPRscreen20240118/Uncertain/", cell_type, "/")
  } else {
    path_CRISPR <- paste0("/Users/wchen20/Desktop/PCAWG/CRISPR/CRISPRscreen20240118/", cell_type, "/")
  }
  
  cripsr_list_all <- list.files(path_CRISPR, pattern = "*.gene_summary.txt", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
  cripsr_list_all <- grep("2_MAGeCK", cripsr_list_all, value = TRUE)
  
  ## Randomly remove one study
  #set.seed(123)
  #remove_idx <- sample(seq_along(cripsr_list_all), 1)
  #removed_file <- cripsr_list_all[remove_idx]
  #cripsr_list <- cripsr_list_all[-remove_idx]
  #removed_file
  
  ## Remove study one by one
  for (i in seq_along(cripsr_list_all)) {
    
    removed_file <- cripsr_list_all[i]
    cripsr_list <- cripsr_list_all[-i]
    study <- sub(paste0(path_CRISPR, "/"), "", removed_file)
    study <- sub("/2_MAGeCK/", "_", study)
    study <- sub(".gene_summary.txt", "", study)
    study <- sub("/", "_", study)
    
    path_RRA_save <- paste0(path_RRA_leaveout, "/", cell_type, "/", study, "/")
    dir.create(path_RRA_save, recursive = T)
  
    ## Positive regulation
    reg="pos"
    sum_list <- lapply(cripsr_list, function(x) rank_extract(x, paste0(reg, "|rank")))
    p_value <- lapply(cripsr_list, function(x) p_extract(x, paste0(reg, "|rank")))
    r = rankMatrix(sum_list, full = TRUE)
  
  long_dt <- rbindlist(
    lapply(seq_along(p_value), function(i) {
      dt <- copy(p_value[[i]])
      setnames(dt, "P_value", "pval")
      dt[, dataset := paste0("ds", i)]
      dt
    })
  )
  
  long_dt[, HumanGene := as.character(HumanGene)]
  result <- long_dt[, .(hommel_p = combine_hommel(na.omit(pval))), by = HumanGene]
  
  normed <- lapply(seq_along(sum_list), function(i) {
    dt <- normalize_list(sum_list[[i]])
    dt[, Screen := paste0("S", i)]
    dt
  })
  
  score_dt <- rbindlist(normed)
  score_dt[, HumanGene := as.character(HumanGene)]
  
  gene_scores <- score_dt[, .(
    mean_score = mean(Rnorm, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_score   = sd(Rnorm, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_screens  = .N
  ), by = HumanGene]
  
  pos <- aggregateRanks(rmat = r, method = "RRA") %>%
    mutate(Score = Score) %>%
    arrange(Score) %>%
    mutate(Rank = row_number(),
           HumanGene = Name) %>% 
    left_join(., result, by = "HumanGene") %>%
    mutate(fdr = p.adjust(hommel_p),
           HumanGene = Name) %>% 
    inner_join(gene_scores, by = "HumanGene")
  
  colnames(pos) <- ifelse(
    colnames(pos) == "HumanGene",
    "HumanGene",
    paste0(colnames(pos), "_", reg)
  )
  
  ## Negtiave regulation
  reg="neg"
  sum_list <- lapply(cripsr_list, function(x) rank_extract(x, paste0(reg, "|rank")))
  p_value <- lapply(cripsr_list, function(x) p_extract(x, paste0(reg, "|rank")))
  
  long_dt <- rbindlist(
    lapply(seq_along(p_value), function(i) {
      dt <- copy(p_value[[i]])
      setnames(dt, "P_value", "pval")
      dt[, dataset := paste0("ds", i)]
      dt
    })
  )
  
  long_dt[, HumanGene := as.character(HumanGene)]
  result <- long_dt[, .(hommel_p = combine_hommel(na.omit(pval))), by = HumanGene]
  
  normed <- lapply(seq_along(sum_list), function(i) {
    dt <- normalize_list(sum_list[[i]])
    dt[, Screen := paste0("S", i)]
    dt
  })
  
  score_dt <- rbindlist(normed)
  score_dt[, HumanGene := as.character(HumanGene)]
  
  gene_scores <- score_dt[, .(
    mean_score = mean(Rnorm, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_score   = sd(Rnorm, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_screens  = .N
  ), by = HumanGene]
  
  r = rankMatrix(sum_list, full = TRUE)
  neg <- aggregateRanks(rmat = r, method = "RRA") %>%
    mutate(Score = Score) %>%
    arrange(Score) %>%
    mutate(Rank = row_number(),
           HumanGene = Name) %>% 
    left_join(., result, by = "HumanGene") %>%
    mutate(fdr = p.adjust(hommel_p),
           HumanGene = Name) %>% 
    inner_join(gene_scores, by = "HumanGene")
  
  colnames(neg) <- ifelse(
    colnames(neg) == "HumanGene",
    "HumanGene",
    paste0(colnames(neg), "_", reg)
  )
  
  all <- inner_join(pos, neg, by = "HumanGene") %>%
    mutate(
      Direction = case_when(
        Rank_pos < Rank_neg & hommel_p_pos < cut_off & mean_score_pos > 0 ~ "Pos",
        Rank_neg < Rank_pos & hommel_p_neg < cut_off & mean_score_neg > 0 ~ "Neg",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      ),
      cell_type = cell_type,
      Score = case_when(
        Direction == "Pos" ~ mean_score_pos,
        Direction == "Neg" ~ -mean_score_neg,
        Direction == "NS"  ~ rowMeans(cbind(mean_score_pos, mean_score_neg), na.rm = TRUE),
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),
      P_value = case_when(
        Direction == "Pos" ~ hommel_p_pos,
        Direction == "Neg" ~ hommel_p_neg,
        Direction == "NS"  ~ cut_off,
        TRUE ~ 1
      )
    )
  
  #dir.create(paste0(path_RRA_save, "/RRA_", cell_type), recursive = TRUE)
  
  write.csv(all, file = paste0(path_RRA_save, "/RRA_", cell_type, ".csv"), row.names = F)
  
  RRA_all = all
  
  pos_sig <- RRA_all %>% filter(cell_type == !!cell_type, Direction == "Pos")
  pos_genelist = pos_sig$Score
  names(pos_genelist) = pos_sig$HumanGene
  pos_genelist = sort(pos_genelist, decreasing = TRUE)
  
  pos_enrich = EnrichAnalyzer(geneList = pos_genelist, 
                              method = "ORT", 
                              type = "Pathway+C5_BP",
                              limit = c(5, 500),
                              pvalueCutoff = 1,
                              organism = "hsa")
  
  pos_en <- pos_enrich@result
  write.csv(pos_en, file = paste0(path_RRA_save, cell_type, "_PathwayC5BPpos_all.csv"), row.names = F, quote = TRUE)
  
  pos_en_sig <- subset(pos_en, `p.adjust` < 0.1)
  pos_en_sig$GeneRatio <- as.character(pos_en_sig$GeneRatio)
  write.csv(pos_en_sig, file = paste0(path_RRA_save, cell_type, "_PathwayC5BPpos_sig.csv"), row.names = F, quote = TRUE)
  
  top10_pos <- EnrichedView_modified(pos_en_sig, top = 10, bottom = 0, mode = 1, title = cell_type)
  ggsave(file = paste0(path_RRA_save, cell_type, "_PathwayC5BPpos.pdf"), top10_pos, width = 6, height = 7, dpi = 300)
  
  neg_sig <- RRA_all %>% filter(cell_type == !!cell_type, Direction == "Neg")
  neg_genelist = neg_sig$Score
  names(neg_genelist) = neg_sig$HumanGene
  neg_genelist = sort(neg_genelist, decreasing = TRUE)
  
  neg_enrich = EnrichAnalyzer(geneList = neg_genelist, 
                              method = "ORT", 
                              type = "Pathway+C5_BP",
                              limit = c(5, 500),
                              pvalueCutoff = 1,
                              organism = "hsa")
  
  neg_en <- neg_enrich@result
  write.csv(neg_en, file = paste0(path_RRA_save, cell_type, "_PathwayC5BPneg_all.csv"), row.names = F, quote = TRUE)
  
  neg_en_sig <- subset(neg_en, `p.adjust` < 0.1)
  neg_en_sig$GeneRatio <- as.character(neg_en_sig$GeneRatio)
  write.csv(neg_en_sig, file = paste0(path_RRA_save, cell_type, "_PathwayC5BPneg_sig.csv"), row.names = F, quote = TRUE)
  
  top10_neg <- EnrichedView_modified(neg_en_sig, top = 0, bottom = 10, mode = 1, title = cell_type)
  ggsave(file = paste0(path_RRA_save, cell_type, "_PathwayC5BPneg.pdf"), top10_neg, width = 6, height = 7, dpi = 300)
  
  }
  
  cripsr_list <- list.files(paste0(path_RRA_leaveout, cell_type), pattern = "RRA_*", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
  
  ## Summarize the results
  RRA_all <- lapply(cripsr_list, fread_file) %>%
  rbindlist() %>%
  filter(HumanGene != "NULL") %>% 
  mutate(Category = case_when(cell_type == "Tcells" ~ "T cell",
                              cell_type == "MHCregulators" ~ "MHC-I regulation",
                              cell_type == "NKcells" ~ "NK cell",
                              cell_type == "Macrophages" ~ "Macrophage",
                              cell_type == "GammadeltaTcells" ~ "gdT cell",
                              TRUE ~ NA),
         Regulation = case_when(
           P_value < 0.001 & Direction != "NS" ~ paste0(Category, "***"),
           P_value < 0.01 & Direction != "NS" ~ paste0(Category, "**"),
           P_value < cut_off & Direction != "NS" ~ paste0(Category, "*"),
           TRUE ~ Category)) 
  write.csv(RRA_all, file = paste0(paste0(path_RRA_leaveout, cell_type), "/RRAcombined_fdr.csv"), row.names = F)
  
}
```

# 3. Summary for CRIPSR studies
```{r, eval = FALSE}
path_revise <- "/Users/wchen20/Desktop/2026-02-16_Draft/Revision/R1Major2/005/Summary/"

cell_types <- c("Tcells", "MHCregulators", "NKcells")
regulators <- c("pos", "neg")

for (cell_type in cell_types) {
   
   for (reg in regulators) {
    
    df_leaveout <- fread(paste0(path_RRA_save, cell_type,"_PathwayC5BP", reg, "_all.csv"))
    
    df_RRA <- fread(paste0(path_revise, cell_type, "_C5BP_", reg, "_list.csv")) %>%
      left_join(., df_leaveout, by = c("ID", "Description")) %>%
      rename_with(~ gsub("\\.x$", "_all_study", .x)) %>%
      rename_with(~ gsub("\\.y$", "_leave_out", .x))
    
    write.csv(df_RRA, paste0(path_revise, cell_type,  "_", reg,"_leaveout.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
      
   }
}

```
